title: Helps me hit my goals
body: I’ve tried a bunch of habit trackers and most feel either too basic or way too complicated. This one hits the sweet spot. It’s quick to check things off, the streaks are motivating without being stressful, and the progress view makes it easy to see how I’m doing at a glance.
